title: Mixer follows a clock line: start on the bar, stop fade, pause, seek, edits at the clock's bar line
description:
## Intent
The `Mixer` follows a clock: start on the next bar line, stop, pause, seek, edits at the clock's next bar line. Makes stories apricitus-a65057 and apricitus-865b9a green and the edit and empty-score scenarios of apricitus-ba8ee6.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-engine/src/mixer.rs`: `Command::Follow(ClockLine)` (a new line for each block or on change) and `Command::FreeRun`; when following, position comes from the clock's beats; `SwapAt::NextBar` counts to the clock's bar line; `Seek` picks the score bar that starts at the next bar line; the clock stopping fades out over `XFADE`.
2. `Status` reports following, the clock's tempo and whether playback waits for a bar line.
3. Free-running behavior unchanged (existing tests in `tests/realtime.rs` stay green).
4. Extend the allocation guard in `tests/realtime.rs` to following mode.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-engine` (clock scenarios for start, stop, pause, seek, edits green; realtime allocation count zero).

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): the mixer follows a beat clock`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
